newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa rand gains more after-hours, bonds steady.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa rand gains more after-hours, bonds steady.

text.p: 1650 GMT - Rand gains further after hours in thin trade, quoted at best 4.6140/6190. Bonds steady.
* Stals tells Reuters sees scope for "very stable" rand in 1997, current account deficit likely to fall to 4.0-5.0 billion rand from 10.0 billion in 1996.
* News cabinet deferred decision on controversial Syrian arms deal received positively offshore.
* Rand last 4.6150/6200 on dollar from 4.6300/6350 at 1400 GMT and 4.6520/6570 at the Tuesday close.
* Bonds holding below crucial 15.50 percent level. R150 last at 15.485 pct from 15.63 pct Tuesday.
